maya_cs: Heads up — Northgrove hit repeated 503s during the onboarding data sync window this morning. Usage spike + retries from their side. Latency p95 jumped ~3x. Escalating because they mentioned retries >5 and are worried about renewal.

sam_eng: Ack. can you paste an example error/log here?

maya_cs: sure, pasted below: 
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:34Z] request_id=abc123 status=503 read_timeout backend=transformer-1 latency_ms=1200
```

aj_sre: looks like connection timeouts hitting our gRPC pool. I opened INC-4123 and temporarily bumped autoscale +1. deploy-bot: rolled back canary 2026-03-19-17:42 due to p95 regressions.

linda_onboard: FYI I paused the scheduled onboarding for Northgrove last night after their report. They're in a fragile state — marking as low-health and potential renewal risk if this repeats.

sam_eng: assigning to me for triage. I'll check KV cache hot keys + model route fallbacks. Will reproduce locally against their sample payload.

maya_cs: Action items (quick):
- sam_eng -> triage KV cache / hot keys and model fallback root cause (due EOD tomorrow)
- aj_sre -> verify autoscale/backpressure settings, create alert for latency>800ms (P95)
- linda_onboard -> own customer comms + check if data format/ingest batching caused retries
- maya_cs -> coordinate enablement follow-up and record feedback to product

aj_sre: noted. Alert created: northgrove.prod.latency_p95 > 800ms. Added short-term SLI retention and a Pager duty rule for INC-4123. Also added an ops note to the runbook.

sam_eng: quick update — found a misrouted quantized model variant causing fallback to CPU decoder for some inference paths (OOM->fallback). PR 578 open with guard and better variant selection logic. Canary running in staging.

maya_cs: timeline look?

sam_eng: deploy plan: staging canary tonight, prod canary tomorrow 10:00am PT, full rollout 14:00 if no regressions. If anything looks off, we'll pause and rollback.

linda_onboard: I can do customer comms. Scheduling a 30m sync for tomorrow 11:00am PT. Will send a pre-call checklist and offer a one-week credit if they see another incident.

maya_cs: also capturing feedback to product: request for clearer docs on data-sync idempotency and an SDK helper for safe retries. Logging under product-feedback/1227.

aj_sre: follow-up: added runbook entry "northgrove-repeat-503" with triage steps and mitigation knobs (link). Assigned eng-platform on-call to monitor for 48h.

maya_cs: thanks team. I'll keep this thread open until prod stabilizes and we confirm no repeat within 48h. tagging: @sam_eng @aj_sre @linda_onboard :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: prod canary rollback detection — no new rollbacks in last 2h.
